newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Editorial calls on government officials and Communist Party members to work arduously and not to be extravagant at the expense of public funds.
- State Development Bank earns about 1.0 billion yuan profits in 1996. To allocate 96 percent of loans this year to 330 large and intermediate projects
- To prevent possible industrial pollution, rural enterprises will undergo strict environmental examinations
- Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources is trying to find more mineral resources which can facilitate agricultural development.
- High technology development zones will be built along the expressway connecting Beijing, Tianjin and Tanggu in north China.
- First Auto Works plans to produce 46,000 sedans in 1997.

- Five new oil and gas fields will be exploited at the Turpan-Hami oil fields in Xinjiang this year while oil production capacity will be brought to 300,000 tonnes and natural gas will reach 424 million cubic metres.
- Japan Import and Export Bank has provided $80 millon in loans to Fuzhou's Changle international airport through the Bank of China.
- Editorial lashes out at irregularities in financial sector, saying strict supervision is necessary
- China Securities Regulatory Commission punished Jiangsu Securities Co for spreading political rumours
- Urban unemployment rate seen at 3.0-3.5 percent in 1997
- China will push forward reform of interest rate system, with first rate adjustment this year seen in March or April
